g.text: Difference = left minus right. Only the automatically served / available intersection is scored; every pair retains all original 120 identities.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: References are hypothetical financial comparators. Trade share counts actual trading periods / 30, including the initial decision.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: New floors can change the shared menu. C's Low=0 does not imply an unchanged target; this is a complete-procedure comparison.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: Top-inner E is a beta tie set, not behavioral equivalence or Profile E. H6 Profile E has its own Q1 annual assessment only.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: Reused development data and overlapping training folds give neither a fresh blind test nor a fixed-policy risk certificate.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: No policy winner is selected. References are hypothetical; different common subsets contain different market paths and fit contexts.
